# Law Offices of Eric A. Boyajian (LOEAB)

> > California's trusted employment law firm specializing in worker rights, wage theft recovery, and workplace justice for employees and employers.

LOEAB is a Glendale-based employment law firm led by Super Lawyers-recognized attorney Eric A. Boyajian, serving California clients in wrongful termination, wage disputes, discrimination, retaliation, and whistleblower cases. The firm has secured landmark settlements exceeding $1.2M in wage theft cases across multiple industries.

## Key Topics

- Employment Law
- Wrongful Termination
- Wage Theft
- Worker Rights
- California Labor Law

- Wage & Hour Disputes
- Harassment

## Practice Areas

- [Wrongful Termination](https://www.loeab.com/practice-area/wrongful-termination): Practice area page covering wrongful termination claims and worker protections
- [Wage & Hour Dispute](https://www.loeab.com/practice-area/wage-hour-dispute): Practice area for wage theft, overtime claims, and misclassification disputes
- [Discrimination](https://www.loeab.com/practice-area/discrimination): Employment discrimination practice area under California FEHA law
- [Retaliation](https://www.loeab.com/practice-area/retaliation): Retaliation claims under CFRA, FMLA, and California employment law
- [Harassment](https://www.loeab.com/practice-area/harassment): Workplace harassment and sexual harassment claims under California law
- [Whistle Blower](https://www.loeab.com/practice-area/whistle-blower): Whistleblower protection under California Whistleblower Protection Act
- [Services for Employers](https://www.loeab.com/employers): Services for employers including compliance, documentation, and workplace investigations
